about: 1C report 'Zagotovka - Reestr PK17 (jadval 7)' (ZagotovkaReestrPK17_J7): the same document, posted only, and the same period field (posting date) as its schema (probe 29.10); every organization in one pass, where the report takes one at a time. The document date and the harvest were added for diagnosis (the first export, 29.10, had 5 rows more than the chat's file of 27.10); the document date is also read by the acceptance check (track, addendum of 29.10 after the second run).
